title: Universal and Transferable Adversarial Attack on Large Language Models Using Exponentiated Gradient Descent
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical optimization of an adversarial attack method (jailbreaking) using Exponentiated Gradient Descent. Although it uses safety benchmarks (like AdvBench and HarmBench) that involve unethical prompts to test the effectiveness of the attack, the research itself is centered on the efficiency of the optimization algorithm rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning or frameworks.
